MyPoint is a mobile application that works as a social network where you can create Polls and consult their Followers on any topic such as: Sports, Cinema, Music, Beauty, Celebrities, Fashion, Politics, Culture, etc.

Make your creativity flies by creating Polls with a question to your Followers in order that they can give you their Point on the options to choose.

You can create a Versus, List, Yes/No or MultiVersus and assign them a specific time for your followers participation, or if you prefer, you can close the post manually.

In polls MyPoint gives you more!

Create your Poll and share it on your favorite social networks.
